limitations: Structural targets are from the author-published workbook; separate coupled MACH results and paper Table 4 are excluded.

The workbook does not identify the tip sampling point. GRID833 is an a priori inferred selector; the 21 tip-rib nodes differ in span by only 3.25e-5 m. No tip value is selected by agreement with the target and no qualified static PASS is claimed.
K6ROT=100000 is retained in the original input. The current CQUADR backend uses its own internal drilling policy, so retaining this card does not imply identical drilling stiffness semantics.
Missing modes and negative finite eigenvalues are failures/diagnostics, never numerical agreement. No mass, material coupling, load or boundary condition is removed to obtain reference agreement.
Negative candidate residuals use the recorded scale-normalized definition; they are not a certificate that all negative finite eigenvalues were found.

Modal comparison uses ascending frequency order. The author workbook supplies scalar natural frequencies, not corresponding eigenvectors; modal assurance/correlation is not established by this scalar comparison.
